---
title: "Meet the practice data"
---


The three supplied files are in `data/example/`.

| File | Structure |
|---|---|
| `feature-counts.tsv` | `feature_id` followed by one integer count column per sample |
| `sample-metadata.tsv` | `sample_id` and `group`, with one row per sample |
| `taxonomy.tsv` | `feature_id` and `taxon`, with one row per feature |

Locate A01 in the count table and metadata. Match one feature ID to its taxonomic label. There are 12 samples per group and 15 fictional features.


::: {.callout-note}
### Match identifiers exactly

A sample ID is the link between its counts and metadata. Check spelling, punctuation, and accidental spaces. A feature ID links a count-table row to its display label.
:::
